request: why does a block of wood float but a block of steel the same size sinks?

beats.intent: Two equal 10 cm cubes, wood and steel, each 1000 cm³
beats.narration: Here are two cubes exactly the same size, ten centimetres on a side: a thousand cubic centimetres each. One is wood, one is steel.
beats.code:
stage.title("Density")
wood = Square(1.0, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.6).move_to([-4.5, 1.2, 0])
steel = Square(1.0, color=GREY_B, fill_opacity=0.9).move_to([-1.5, 1.2, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(wood), FadeIn(steel))
stage.add(wood, steel)
stage.label(wood, "wood", direction=UP, color=ORANGE)
stage.label(steel, "steel", direction=UP, color=GREY_B)
stage.play(FadeIn(Text("each 1000 cm³", font_size=26).move_to([-3.0, 0.3, 0])))

beats.intent: Bars beside each cube for their masses: 600 g and 7900 g
beats.narration: Weigh them. The wood is six hundred grams; the steel is seven thousand nine hundred.
beats.code:
bw = Rectangle(width=0.3, height=2.2 * 600 / 7900, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.8).next_to(wood, RIGHT, buff=0.2, aligned_edge=DOWN)
bs = Rectangle(width=0.3, height=2.2, color=GREY_B, fill_opacity=0.8).next_to(steel, RIGHT, buff=0.2, aligned_edge=DOWN)
stage.play(GrowFromEdge(bw, DOWN), GrowFromEdge(bs, DOWN))
stage.add(bw, bs)
stage.label(bw, "600 g", direction=RIGHT, color=ORANGE)
stage.label(bs, "7900 g", direction=RIGHT, color=GREY_B)

beats.intent: Both cubes dropped into a tank: wood floating with 60% under the surface, steel on the bottom
beats.narration: Drop them in water. Water is one gram per cubic centimetre. The wood floats with sixty percent under the surface; the steel sinks straight to the bottom.
beats.code:
stage.clear(keep=(wood, steel))
water = Rectangle(width=5, height=2.0, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.3).move_to([-3.0, -1.6, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(water))
stage.add(water)
stage.play(wood.animate.move_to([-4.3, -0.7, 0]), steel.animate.move_to([-1.8, -2.1, 0]), run_time=1.5)
stage.add(wood, steel)
stage.label(wood, "floats", direction=UP, color=ORANGE)
stage.label(steel, "sinks", direction=UP, color=GREY_B)

beats.intent: The tank beside density = mass ÷ volume: 0.6 and 7.9 g/cm³ against water's 1
beats.narration: Density is mass divided by volume. Wood is nought point six grams per cubic centimetre, less than water, so it floats. Steel is seven point nine, so it sinks.

request: why do snowshoes stop you sinking into snow?

beats.intent: A person standing on snow, an arrow for their 600 N weight
beats.narration: A person weighs about six hundred newtons. That force presses down through their feet into the snow.
beats.code:
stage.title("Pressure on snow")
snow = Rectangle(width=6.5, height=1.4, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.25).move_to([-3, -1.9, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(snow))
stage.add(snow)
p1 = VGroup(Circle(radius=0.2, color=WHITE).move_to([-4.5, 0.5, 0]), Line([-4.5, 0.3, 0], [-4.5, -0.6, 0]), Line([-4.5, -0.6, 0], [-4.7, -1.2, 0]), Line([-4.5, -0.6, 0], [-4.3, -1.2, 0]))
w1 = Arrow([-3.8, 0.6, 0], [-3.8, -0.7, 0], buff=0, color=RED)
stage.play(FadeIn(p1), GrowArrow(w1))
stage.add(p1, w1)
stage.label(w1, "600 N", direction=RIGHT, color=RED)

beats.intent: The person sinking into the snow: all 600 N on 0.04 m² of feet
beats.narration: Their two feet cover only about nought point nought four square metres, so the snow under them gives way and they sink.
beats.code:
stage.play(p1.animate.shift(0.5 * DOWN), run_time=1.2)
stage.add(p1)
stage.label(p1, "feet: 0.04 m²", direction=LEFT, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: A second person on wide snowshoes, the same 600 N, staying on top
beats.narration: Same weight on snowshoes: they spread it over about nought point four square metres, ten times the area, and the person stays on top.
beats.code:
p2 = VGroup(Circle(radius=0.2, color=WHITE).move_to([-1.5, 0.5, 0]), Line([-1.5, 0.3, 0], [-1.5, -0.6, 0]), Line([-1.5, -0.6, 0], [-1.7, -1.15, 0]), Line([-1.5, -0.6, 0], [-1.3, -1.15, 0]))
shoes = Ellipse(width=1.6, height=0.18, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to([-1.5, -1.2, 0])
w2 = Arrow([-0.5, 0.6, 0], [-0.5, -0.7, 0], buff=0, color=RED)
stage.play(FadeIn(p2), FadeIn(shoes), GrowArrow(w2))
stage.add(p2, shoes, w2)
stage.label(w2, "600 N", direction=RIGHT, color=RED)
stage.label(shoes, "snowshoes: 0.4 m²", direction=DOWN, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: The picture beside pressure = force ÷ area: 600 ÷ 0.04 = 15 000 Pa and 600 ÷ 0.4 = 1500 Pa
beats.narration: Pressure is force divided by area. Ten times the area means a tenth of the pressure.

request: why is a cone's volume a third of a cylinder's?

beats.intent: A cone and a cylinder with the same base and height
beats.narration: Take a cone and a cylinder with the same circular base and the same height.
beats.code:
stage.title("Volume of a cone")
r, h = 1.0, 2.6
base_y = -2.0
cone = VGroup(Polygon([-5.5, base_y, 0], [-3.5, base_y, 0], [-4.5, base_y + h, 0], color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.5), Ellipse(width=2 * r, height=0.4, color=ORANGE).move_to([-4.5, base_y, 0]))
cyl = VGroup(Line([-2.5, base_y, 0], [-2.5, base_y + h, 0]), Line([-0.5, base_y, 0], [-0.5, base_y + h, 0]), Ellipse(width=2 * r, height=0.4).move_to([-1.5, base_y + h, 0]), Ellipse(width=2 * r, height=0.4).move_to([-1.5, base_y, 0])).set_color(WHITE)
stage.play(Create(cone), Create(cyl))
stage.add(cone, cyl)
stage.label(cone, "cone", direction=UP, color=ORANGE)
stage.label(cyl, "cylinder", direction=UP)

beats.intent: The cone's sand poured into the cylinder, filling it a third of the way
beats.narration: Fill the cone with sand and tip it into the cylinder. It fills exactly a third.
beats.code:
layers = [Rectangle(width=2 * r, height=h / 3, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.6, stroke_width=0).move_to([-1.5, base_y + h / 6 + k * h / 3, 0]) for k in range(3)]
stage.play(TransformFromCopy(cone[0], layers[0]), run_time=1.2)
stage.add(layers[0])
stage.label(layers[0], "1 cone", direction=RIGHT, color=ORANGE)

beats.intent: Two more cones poured in, filling the cylinder to the top
beats.narration: A second cone fills two thirds, and a third cone fills it to the brim.
beats.code:
for k in (1, 2):
    stage.play(TransformFromCopy(cone[0], layers[k]), run_time=1.0)
    stage.add(layers[k])
stage.label(VGroup(*layers), "3 cones = 1 cylinder", direction=RIGHT, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: The picture beside V = 1/3 π r² h, and r = 3, h = 10 gives 30π ≈ 94.2
beats.narration: So a cone's volume is a third of pi r squared h. A cone of radius three and height ten holds thirty pi, about ninety four cubic centimetres.

request: how do you find the surface area of a 3 by 2 by 1 cm box?

beats.intent: A cuboid 3 cm long, 2 cm high and 1 cm deep
beats.narration: A box is three centimetres long, two high and one deep. How much card covers it?
beats.code:
stage.title("Surface area of a box")
k = 0.6
front = Rectangle(width=3 * k, height=2 * k, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.4).move_to([-3, -0.2, 0])
off = np.array([0.35, 0.35, 0])
top = Polygon(front.get_corner(UL), front.get_corner(UR), front.get_corner(UR) + off, front.get_corner(UL) + off, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.4)
side = Polygon(front.get_corner(UR), front.get_corner(DR), front.get_corner(DR) + off, front.get_corner(UR) + off, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.4)
box = VGroup(front, top, side)
stage.play(Create(box))
stage.add(box)
stage.label(Line(front.get_corner(DL), front.get_corner(DR)), "3 cm", direction=DOWN)
stage.label(Line(front.get_corner(DL), front.get_corner(UL)), "2 cm", direction=LEFT)
stage.label(Line(front.get_corner(DR), front.get_corner(DR) + off), "1 cm", direction=RIGHT)

beats.intent: The box unfolded into its net of six rectangles
beats.narration: Unfold it flat. The net has six rectangles.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
specs = (((-1.5, 3), (3, 1), GREEN, "3"), ((-1.5, 2), (3, 2), BLUE, "6"), ((-1.5, 0), (3, 1), GREEN, "3"), ((-1.5, -1), (3, 2), BLUE, "6"), ((-2.5, 2), (1, 2), ORANGE, "2"), ((1.5, 2), (1, 2), ORANGE, "2"))
c = np.array([-3, 0.0, 0])
net = VGroup()
for (x, y), (wd, ht), col, a in specs:
    net.add(Rectangle(width=wd * k, height=ht * k, color=WHITE, fill_color=col, fill_opacity=0.3).move_to(c + k * np.array([x + wd / 2, y - ht / 2, 0])))
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(f) for f in net], lag_ratio=0.2))
stage.add(net)

beats.intent: The faces coloured in matching pairs, each showing its area: 6, 6, 3, 3, 2, 2
beats.narration: The faces come in pairs: front and back are three by two, six each; top and bottom three by one, three each; the ends two by one, two each.
beats.code:
stage.play(*[f.animate.set_fill(opacity=0.6) for f in net])
stage.play(*[FadeIn(Text(a, font_size=26).move_to(f)) for f, (_, _, _, a) in zip(net, specs)])
stage.label(net, "areas in cm²", direction=RIGHT)

beats.narration: Add one of each pair and double it: two times eleven is twenty two square centimetres.
